research.notes: Closed right now: the program page says "Applications are not being accepted at this time" and that the intake ended August 31, 2026 (DECISIONS #19); the weekly live check flags the page when it changes. Rules are from the 2026-27 applicant's guide, section 1.1 (3 to 500 full-time employees, $300,000 to $100 million revenue: the 2026-27 minimums the brief asked to check). Structure: the guide accepts "an incorporated legal entity, limited liability partnership (LLP), or cooperative" and lists sole proprietorships and limited partnerships as ineligible; a non-profit is not for-profit. The profile has one "Partnership" answer covering general, limited and LLP, so partnership is not excluded by the rule and the LLP condition is a check-yourself item (this should become `unclear: [partnership]` once core supports it). Type: the page and guide say "funding" and the guide has a "Grants vs. contributions" section whose wording I did not settle, so funding_types is empty (Unknown). Page text note: the guide's HTML carries a JSON copy of each text block, so pageText has most sentences twice, once with literal \r\n and  . Quotes here are chosen from sentences whose first occurrence is the clean copy, so their context reads normally. Contacts are email only; no phone is on either page.
